data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis): [implicit_assumption] task-7's >=4-match query MUST derive from the same canonical extraction that task-1 (9d70) defines as SCAN_RESULT query_used, that Phase G (task-5c) copies verbatim into the trailer, and that the hook (task-2b) parses. task-7 currently depends only on task-6; pin it to replicate task-1's query semantics so the regression count, the production trailer, and the hook parse agree on what 'matches=4' means — otherwise the test passes green against a query production never emits, defeating recurrence prevention.
